import re
import sys

values = {}
for instruction in sys.stdin.read().split(";"):
    instruction = instruction.strip()
    if not instruction:
        continue
    match = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*(\d+|[A-Za-z_]\w*)", instruction)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid instruction: {instruction}")
    target, source = match.groups()
    values[target] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

order = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in order) + ";")
